summary: Verified Intl Shipments sortable table headers, clickable tile row shortcuts, and Activity timeline formatting per iteration_81 spec. All targeted behaviors pass and no regressions observed.

critical_code_review_comments: IntlShipmentsPage.tsx (~490 lines) still combines list + Detail — extraction into IntlShipmentDetail.tsx recommended.

fmtAt only formats MM-DD-YYYY timestamps; entries created via `create()` use a locale string ('MM/DD/YYYY, h:mm A') so their activity dates will fall through unformatted in the timeline. Consider normalizing.
Sort dependency array uses eslint-disable — safe today but hides potential missed deps in future refactors.
